verdict.rationale: Proa ships a first-party CLI (`proa-cli`, installed via cargo). It covers scaffolding (`proa new site`, with non-interactive `--yes`), component vendoring (`proa ui add`), route inspection (`proa site routes`), formatting checks (`proa fmt --check --verify`) and self-update (`proa update`). It also has an AI-native touch: `proa new site` scaffolds an AGENTS.md file by default. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) CLI output for agent consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: `proa ui add button` vendors the source into `src/components/`
Check the route table: proa site routes
`proa new site` scaffolds the file by default (pass `--no-agents-md` to skip it
Once installed, update with proa update, or preview the latest stable version with proa update --check.
